note: Four ranged pairs (a projectile and the impact played where it arrives), five single effects, one per common category, and the kaiju set (world scale, a sweepable beam with its charge, a photographic explosion). Scores and verdicts are an independent review (0-3 per rubric criterion) of renders in the skill's default capsule Lab, kept as a reference, not as verification of your build.

pairs.name: fire
teaches: boiling flipbook head with a stretched comet tail
world-space trails that cool into smoke
lopsided fireball thrown along the shot
dark scorch under glowing cracks
emissive strokes decaying into grey smoke (decay())

pairs.name: ice
teaches: crystal meshes with fresnel edges instead of painted spikes
navy alpha backing for value contrast on a bright core
prism fringe as a complementary accent
overshoot scale curve on eruption, then a timed shatter

pairs.name: poison
teaches: lobbed flight (arc) with a Track thread drawing the path
deformed procedural mesh as a glossy liquid body
complementary purple dark core and bruise smoke
colour ramps that cool acid green to murky grey
drops that collide with the floor

pairs.name: dark
teaches: an alpha-black body (Blend) that reads against a bright stage instead of another glow
inward motion: needles, dust and rubble eased into the centre (EaseInCubic travel)
a tilted accretion disk drawn in two halves so the horizon occludes its far side
a black impact frame before the white release
an orange complementary accent at 5-10% of the frame

singles.name: hit
teaches: two-frame anticipation before a 5-frame white contact
jagged burst dissolving through a noise mask (DISSOLVE)
three spark tiers (spark_burst) that burst fast, then hang and droop
refraction wave and air bubble instead of a flat shock ring

singles.name: slash
teaches: slash_set: one blade read at three widths (afterimage, body, hot edge) plus a cel crescent
swing(): the arc lies in a yawed 3D swing plane, not painted on the screen
flame tongues peeling off the arc, hidden behind the body by depth test
embers and thin cut smoke as the exit

singles.name: charge
teaches: a long inward build (about one second) before exactly one release
orbit_band gyroscope rings on two tilted planes that tighten
imploding shells: the gather reads as a collapsing volume
release flash, bloom and sparks only at the end

singles.name: shield
teaches: fresnel shell and rim (falloff pow < 1 for a thin rim)
overshoot pop, a hold with scan bands, then a timed break
shell_fragments: real spherical sheets that separate when cutoff alone opens no visible holes
every fragment cleared before the duration ends

singles.name: heal
teaches: no impact frame: slow fade-in instead of a white contact
floor seal decal as the identity
rings, plus signs and motes that all travel upward and ease out
a gentle body bloom instead of a burst

sets.name: kaiju
teaches: scale='kaiju': recipes written at character scale, built 40x larger and 2.5x slower (references/scale.md)
charge_chain(): arcs lighting a chain of anchors one after another, re-struck mirrored
beam(): a sustained beam whose length and power the game drives through bind equations (Vfx.beam(), aim(), release())
photographic colour and brightness for fire, soot and smoke (references/realism.md)
soft particles where smoke meets the ground

historical_review.stage: the skill's default Lab (capsule stand-ins, standard view, default profile)
historical_review.reviewers: two independent subagents that saw only the strips, key-frame sheets, manifest entries and flags

VFX_Projectile_Fire.fix: The trail smoke advects along the shot with the fireball (f27 near caster -> f42/f47 piled on the target) instead of lingering on the path; spawn the smoke layer in world space with no inherited projectile velocity and a slow eased upward drift so f42-f54 show a graded smoke line along the path that rises and thins.

VFX_Fire_Explosion.fix: The inward gather at f1-f4 is only a faint orange glow on the target and does not read; make the pre-detonation layer at f1-f7 a visible bright ember core with streaks converging on the target so the first lit tile already says fire.

VFX_Projectile_Ice.fix: The lance (f1-f21) renders as one flat saturated blue wedge with only point sparkles on it; replace its texture/colour curve with a white-hot spine down the centre, a cyan-blue body and a navy rim (and add a thin additive white ribbon core inside the wedge) so the peak tiles f4-f13 show three brightness bands instead of a flat plastic colour.

VFX_Ice_Spikes.fix: The crystal cluster fades/sinks away between f30 and f48 and only small chips appear at f53; instead, at the glint f48 swap the main crystals for 5-8 large shard pieces of the same crystals that split off and fall over f50-f66, so the cluster visibly cracks apart rather than dissolving.

VFX_Projectile_Poison.fix: The glob body f3-f42 is mostly a flat olive fill with a lime rim and one white dot; darken the centre of the glob layer toward a visible purple core (radial colour gradient or a second smaller dark alpha-blend sprite inside) and widen the white wet highlight into a short crescent so the strongest tiles read as highlight / acid body / dark core.

VFX_Poison_Cloud.fix: After the splash, the fume body f30-f68 is a thin translucent haze that only fades uniformly; make the fume layer denser and drive an alpha-threshold dissolve (noise erosion) from f40 to f80 so it breaks into separate low clumps that pile downwind rather than just lowering opacity.

VFX_Projectile_Dark.fix: Nothing is left on the path behind the orb (f16-f36 path is empty; f45 only faint wisps on the target, f54-f60 empty); emit the broken wisp strokes and grey smoke wake in world space along the path from f6 to f30 with a 25-35 frame life that cools magenta to grey, plus a few hanging glints, so f40-f54 show a deliberate fading streak along the line of flight.

VFX_Dark_Vortex.fix: The black-horizon sphere f6-f56 is a clean round disc that only scales up and then shrinks; apply UV distortion/noise erosion to its rim and a tilted, torn accretion-disk ring that rotates with it from f6 to f56 so the outline wobbles and tears before the collapse at f60-f61.

VFX_Hit_Heavy.fix: The two-frame anticipation is effectively invisible: f1-f2 show only a faint glint on the target's chest. Make the pre-flash layer at f1-f2 a readable inward pinch (small bright core plus 4-6 short streaks converging on the contact point) so the white flash at f3-f5 lands after a visible wind-up.

VFX_Slash_Fire.fix: The blade arc at f3-f8 is a flat pale cream; tint the arc body to saturated orange-red with a dark red trailing rim, keeping white only along the leading edge and the contact flash at f4-f5, so the slash itself reads as fire before the flame puffs appear at f11.

VFX_Magic_Charge.fix: At the release f65-f68 and the tightened core f56-f63 everything is white plus pale blue; add a deep violet/navy rim layer behind the core and on the outer edge of the release shell (f68-f76) so there is a dark outer band under the white core and blue body.

VFX_Shield_Dome.fix: During the hold f18-f80 the dome is a static flat blue sphere with only a faint scan band; drive a scrolling hex/noise UV distortion or a brighter scan band that clearly sweeps bottom-to-top every ~20 frames so the shell surface visibly moves between f18, f32, f70 and f80.

VFX_Heal.fix: At the plateau f31-f40 the column is one flat mint green; add a white-hot inner core streak rising through the caster's body and a deeper teal/darker green outer fringe on the column edges so the peak tile shows core, body and rim.

VFX_Kaiju_Atomic_Charge.fix: Raise the mouth-gather orb, its spark spray and the f161-f163 handover flash/streak by about half a head height and pull them back toward the face, so from f116 to f163 they sit on the head's mouth instead of floating in front of the neck/upper chest; keep the arc from the top plate ending on that new point.

VFX_Kaiju_Atomic_Beam.fix: From f30 to f224 the beam body reads as a static rigid rod (f72, f113, f160 and f225 show the same uniform line, with only the endpoint moving). Give the blue body layer a streaky noise texture that scrolls outward along the beam's UV, and add a slight width pulse of about +/-15% every 8-12 frames, so streams visibly travel from the mouth to the impact. Keep the white core line steady so the layering stays intact.

VFX_Kaiju_Explosion.fix: The smoke column is thin translucent wisps by f288 and the frame is completely empty from about f312 to f351 (the last ~0.6 s). Stretch the smoke column layer's alpha fade and lifetime so a faint, still-rising and thinning column remains through f340 and reaches zero only at f345, instead of finishing around f300.

historical_review.note: VFX_Projectile_Ice and VFX_Projectile_Dark were judged iterate: they are complete, buildable examples with a known weakest point, not finished baselines. The kaiju set was reviewed on 2026-10-12 the same way (independent subagents that saw only the strips, key-frame sheets, manifest entries and flags), on its own renders in the scaled Lab.
